title: Android TextView: wide characters
purpose: Check the improved wrap-content width estimate for wide CJK characters and joined emoji.
changes: The fallback uses Unicode width categories: wide graphemes receive about one em instead of the previous 0.6 em. Combining marks and joined emoji are still counted as one grapheme.
steps: At the top, compare the colored boxes containing an accented e, plain e, 中, and the joined woman-at-laptop emoji.
The accented and plain e boxes should have equal width. The CJK and emoji boxes should be wider, giving those characters more space.
Choose OK if it looks correct, or Reject with details and your device.
expected: The wide-character boxes are wider than the plain-letter boxes, and the accent does not create extra width.
limits: Unicode terminal-width categories are a heuristic for proportional fonts. Actual emoji and CJK glyph advances, kerning, full shaping and Android device parity are not yet verified; the appearance of emoji depends on your device font.

references.scope: Unicode width categories; font widths are estimated separately.

validation: The full libbhoo Rust test suite and 156 XML importer tests passed. Tests cover CJK, joined emoji, flags, combining marks and line wrapping.
A 320 × 650 browser pixel test checked the four example widths; the archive contains the MIT and Unicode licenses.
